Assumption_Description: S21 is an SAP NetWeaver 7.5 / BW 7.5 or BW/4HANA system on HANA DB
Validation_Method: Verify via SAP GUI System Status & installed software components
Impact_If_Invalid: Architecture must adapt to classical vs modern BW metadata schemas

Assumption_Description: SAP Datasphere tenant is available with Spaces configured for analytical modeling
Validation_Method: Check Datasphere space permissions and user roles
Impact_If_Invalid: Requires manual space provisioning before artifact import

Assumption_Description: SAP GUI and Eclipse BW Modeling Tools are accessible locally on Windows host
Validation_Method: Audit local file paths and registry entries
Impact_If_Invalid: Fall back to offline metadata fixtures and XML/JSON parsers

Assumption_Description: All S21 read operations can be performed with standard authorization profiles (S_RS_COMP, S_TABU_DIS)
Validation_Method: Test metadata read commands against sample InfoArea
Impact_If_Invalid: Request explicit basis security role adjustment if authorization fails
